purpose: Development controls, not fresh nonauthor acceptance

manual_truth.empty: The only partition is empty; its cost is zero.
manual_truth.one_matching: The source leaf block is itself an agreement, with one block minus one source.
manual_truth.two_clear: The two displayed cherries are disjoint target embeddings and give two blocks minus two sources.
manual_truth.crossed_quartet: A zero-cost partition would retain both owner pairs; their target minimal embeddings both contain the root. Split one pair to get three blocks and cost one.
manual_truth.six_caterpillar: Every two of the three owner-pair hulls overlap along the caterpillar spine; at most one pair can remain unsplit. Five blocks are necessary and retaining {2,5} plus four singleton leaves attains five minus three = two.
manual_truth.permuted: A bijective relabeling, child swaps, and reordered sources of the crossed quartet preserve the explicit one-overlap obstruction.

pass_criteria: All seven literal guards and six exact minima agree with this pin; each deliberately mismatched expected minimum must be caught; false Lean assertions must fail; no expected values may be regenerated from DP output.
